# bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/reduce_remove_hydrogens

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of the Ambertools reduce module for removing hydrogens from a given structure.

Reduce is a program for adding or removing hydrogens to a Protein DataBank (PDB) molecular structure file.

Nextflow adapter of the [ReduceRemoveHydrogens](https://biobb-chemistry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ambertools.html#module-ambertools.reduce_remove_hydrogens) building block of [biobb_chemistry](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_REMOVE_HYDROGENS } from 'bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/reduce_remove_hydrogens'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_REMOVE_HYDROGENS(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output file |
| `versions_biobb_chemistry` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_chemistry', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ReduceRemoveHydrogens properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_chemistry container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_REMOVE_HYDROGENS' {
        ext.properties = [binary_path: 'reduce']
    }
}
```
